tbesh_html:
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.2.45;
son of: Shammai (H8060H)
§ Maon or Maonites = "habitation"
1) a man of Judah
2) the inhabitants of the city of Maon
3) a city of Judah located 8 miles south of Hebron

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Maon, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
strongs_1890.derivation: the same as H4583 (מָעוֹן); a residence;
strongs_1890.kjv_def: Maon, Maonites. Compare H1010 (בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן), H4586 (מְעוּנִי)lemma מְעוּנָי third vowel, corrected to מְעוּנִי.
